notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: I read the complete held EO 8061 (4 FR 1181, Mar 7, 1939): transfers a Christiansted, St. Croix block from Interior to Treasury for post-office purposes and modifies EO 5602 to the extent necessary. It is a one-time executed transfer with no own-term; no held ACT:, TERM: or ACTOR_TEXT: evidence shows a later transfer, release or revocation, and no CURRENT predicate exists for a land-jurisdiction order. The catalog 'Amends: EO 5602' and 1989 printed snapshot are leads. Neither NO nor YES supportable. Blocked pending a source on later disposition of the property.
